response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, ratio, film_count, ratio - (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) AS diff_from_avg_ratio FROM r ORDER BY rating

assumptions.assumption: The 'plain average of the five rating-level values' is the unweighted mean of the five per-rating ratios of averages, not a film-weighted or overall ratio.
Number of films is COUNT(*) of films in each rating; every film has a rating, so no null group arises.
